funding_source: none declared
notes: No sample size calculation reported. Small sample size (n=15 per group). Control group received no periodontal treatment. No change in diabetic medication or diet was made for participants during the study.

trial_design: 2-arm randomized controlled trial (parallel), examiner masked to systemic status
funding_source: Xiamen Health Bureau (grant number: WSK 2012-01) and the National Institute of Hospital Administration (the hierarchical medical treatment policy in diabetes project)
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Limitations: elderly subjects limit generalizability; only 3-month follow-up. 44 subjects randomized, 39 completed (3 lost in intervention group, 2 in control group).

trial_design: 2-arm randomized controlled trial with blinded examiners
funding_source: Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo – FAPESP, São Paulo, Brazil, under protocol numbers 2011/06982-4;10057-4;18618-5
notes: Sample size calculated assuming 2 mm PPD reduction (SD 0.6) in IT group and 1 mm (SD 0.6) in ST group, 90% power, 5% significance; n=11 per group required, 12 recruited. No conflict of interest declared.

funding_source: SEPA (research grant); University of Barcelona (research grant)
notes: Sample size: 36 patients/group needed (80% power, α=5%); adjusted to 48 CG and 42 TG for 20% dropout. More smokers in TG than CG at baseline (p=.02). No conflicts of interest declared. Bacteriological PCR data showed poor correlation with clinical/metabolic outcomes.

trial_design: 3-arm randomized controlled clinical trial (parallel groups, examiner and participant blinded)
funding_source: NR
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size calculated based on pilot study (alpha=0.05, power=80%). Limitations include: sample size insufficient to analyze moderate/severe periodontitis separately, plasma inflammatory markers not assessed, long-term follow-up (≥6 months) not performed, drug dosage not recorded.

funding_source: "11th Five-Year" National Science and Technology Support Project (2007BAI18B02)
notes: Sample size calculated using PASS software with 80% statistical power, requiring 20 control and 40 treatment patients (d=0.05). No conflict of interest statement provided. Authors note small sample size as a limitation for the reclassification analysis.

trial_design: prospective, single-blinded, randomized controlled clinical trial with two parallel groups
funding_source: none declared (funded by the authors)
notes: Sample size based on HbA1c difference of 0.3% (SD 1.6%) at 3 months, requiring 42 patients per group (80% power, 95% CI). No conflicts of interest declared. Limitations include short follow-up (3 months) and sample size. ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT03783845.

setting: university dental hospital, postgraduate medical institute
trial_design: randomized control trial with parallel groups (treatment vs no-treatment), stratified by glycemic control, with blinded outcome assessor
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size calculated based on expected mean difference in HbA1c of ~0.4% with SD of 0.4, requiring at least 22 patients per group (90% power, two-sided alpha 0.05). Nine patients withdrew after 3 months (5 treatment, 4 no-treatment) and were included via last-observation-carried-forward. Limitations: small single-center sample; no systemic inflammatory markers (TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1) measured; PISA may not precisely quantify 3D inflammatory burden. Conflict of interest: none declared.

funding_source: National Institutes of Health Clinical and Translational Award ULI RR024148 and KL2 RR024149 from the National Center For Research Resources
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size calculated based on 0.5% difference in HbA1c change (SD 0.85%) between groups; 77 per group needed for 90% power (α=0.05), including 20% attrition. Limitations: low socioeconomic Hispanic population may not represent general population; dietary choices and physical activity not assessed; some participants referred for medical consultation during study, resulting in medication changes that significantly correlated with HbA1c change.

funding_source: Key Projects in the National Science and Technology Pillar Program in the Eleventh 5-Year Plan Periods (Grant 2007 BAI 18 B 02); Science and Technology Planning Project of Guangdong Province, China (Grant 2010B031600117)
notes: Study was underpowered (planned n=53/group, achieved n=41-43/group); no conflicts of interest declared. Sample size calculated assuming 80% power, two-sided alpha=0.05, SD=1.0%, expected HbA1c change of -0.50%, -0.30%, and 0.10% for the three groups.

funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size: 14 subjects per arm needed for 90% power to detect 1% difference in HbA1c (SD 0.8); study did not measure inflammatory markers; long-term effects not determined; no competing interests declared; retrospectively registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.

trial_design: single center double-blind with two parallel-groups, randomized controlled trial
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size calculated with alpha=0.05, beta=0.02, power=80%, minimum 68 participants per group to detect 0.5% HbA1c difference; participants not masked to allocation (only statistician blinded); authors declare no conflict of interest; study limitation noted as short follow-up period.

setting: university hospital outpatient clinic, university dental clinic
funding_source: University of Malaya Research grants P0027/2009B and RG344/11
notes: Sample size calculated for 80% power to detect 1% HbA1c difference (15 subjects/arm); trial not double-blinded; small sample size; no conflict of interest declared.

setting: Department of Veterans Affairs medical centers
trial_design: multi-site, single-blind, randomized, controlled clinical trial with a two by two design
funding_source: Department of Veterans Affairs Health Services Research & Development Service, Career Development Program, VA HSR&D QUERI DII 99.206, NIH K24 DE00419, and Boston University
notes: Study was underpowered (165 enrolled vs. 300 planned); 80% power to detect effect size of 0.40 with 100/group. VA population limits generalizability (97% male). Physician notification of poor glycemic control may have biased results toward null. Equipment/materials donated by Dentsply International (ultrasonic scalers) and Colgate Oral Pharmaceuticals (chlorhexidine PerioGard).

setting: dental college hospital, medical college hospital
trial_design: 3-arm prospective randomized parallel arm clinical trial
funding_source: none declared
notes: Sample size: at least 15 per group estimated for 90% power (p<0.05). Subjects not blinded to treatment. Limitations: small sample size, lack of nondiabetic control group, block randomization may introduce selection bias. Conflict of interest: None.

funding_source: Ministry of Health and Welfare of Japan (H16-Iryo-020) and the Mitsui Sumitomo insurance foundation
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sub-analysis dividing intervention group by CRP response (CRP-D vs CRP-N) was post-hoc, based on multiple regression results. No sample-size calculation reported.

funding_source: National Health and Medical Research Council: Project grant #627100; National Heart Foundation of Australia Future Leader Fellowship #100419; University of Adelaide Divisional Scholarship
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Post hoc power calculation: 19% power with n=62; 398 participants needed for adequate power. This is a secondary subgroup analysis of the PerioCardio trial, which was designed to investigate vascular endpoints, not glycaemic control.

number_of_centres: 2 centres (Peja's Regional Hospital and Dental Polyclinic of Peja)
trial_design: 4-arm open-label randomized clinical trial (2 arms for T2DM patients: tooth extraction only vs. tooth extraction + FM-SRP; 2 arms for non-diabetic patients: tooth extraction only vs. tooth extraction + FM-SRP)
funding_source: Slovenian Human Resources Development and Scholarship Fund (SHRDSF)
notes: Sample size calculation: effect size d=0.5, alpha error probability 0.08, power 0.8, resulting in 26 patients per group. No conflict of interest declared. Study described as a preliminary report.

funding_source: Higher Education Commission of Pakistan, National Research Program for Universities (NRPU) Grants [Grant No: 7143]
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Minimum sample size was n=105 (35/group); raised to n=150 with 40% attrition allowance. Large dropout at follow-up (74/150 at 6 months); reasons not systematically recorded. COVID-19 lockdown caused some missed final follow-up visits.

trial_design: six-month case-control, prospective, non-randomized study with two groups
funding_source: Organon (drug gift)
notes: Tibolone paper: authors disclose no relevant financial relationships; drug (Livial, Organon) provided as gift. CT schizophrenia paper: small sample (n=22 patients) noted as a limitation. Periodontal therapy papers: small sample sizes noted.

setting: outpatient medical and dental clinics, community
trial_design: 2-arm, single-masked, multicenter, parallel-group randomized clinical trial
funding_source: National Institute of Dental and Craniofacial Research, National Institutes of Health (grants U01 DE018902 and U01 DE018886)
notes: Sample size: 600 planned (90% power to detect 0.6% HbA1c difference); enrollment stopped early at 514 due to futility (conditional power threshold <40%). Conflicts of interest declared by Gelato (Endocrine Society travel), Sequist (consultant fees, grants from ADA/Eli Lilly/NIH), Lewis (grant from Novo Nordisk), Katanick (consultant, grant from Zimmer Dental), Paquette (board member and speaker for Colgate-Palmolive, consultant for MIS Implant Technologies). Sponsor had no role in study design, data collection, analysis, or manuscript preparation.

setting: hospital, primary care (general medical and dental practices)
trial_design: 12 month, single-centre, parallel-group, investigator-masked, randomised trial
funding_source: Diabetes UK (08/0003594 and 08/0003741); UK Department of Health's National Institute for Health Research Biomedical Research Centre at University College London/University College London Hospitals
notes: Sample size: 129 participants per group needed to detect 1% HbA1c difference (SD 2.1) at 12 months, α=0.05, 95% power, assuming 10% loss to follow-up. No competing interests declared. Single-centre study; potential recruitment bias acknowledged. Some baseline differences in non-diabetes medications between groups.

funding_source: NR
notes: Authors note that study population had moderate pocket depths (3-4mm), limiting comment on HbA1c differences between more/less severe periodontitis. Control group received no periodontal treatment for 3 months; treated after study completion. No conflict of interest or sample size calculation reported.

number_of_centres: 2 (Queen Mary Hospital and Prince Philip Dental Hospital)
funding_source: Hong Kong Research Grants Council (GRF No. HKU 768411M and 17155216) and Modern Dental Laboratory/HKU Endowment Fund to LJ
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Sample size calculated using G*Power 3.0. Limitations include small sample size (PCR array performed in only 4/11 treatment patients), blood samples taken only at baseline and 6 months (short-term effects may be underestimated), TLR-related protein profile of EPCs not assessed, and no comparison between DM and non-DM subjects.

funding_source: French Ministry of Health Clinical Research Hospital Program '2008' (Programme Hospitalier de Recherche Clinique inter-régional 0803108 [PHRCI]); ACTEON® Group (equipment); Oral-B France (part-time staff)
notes: Sample size calculated to detect 0.5% change in HbA1c; 64 participants/group needed for 80% power; initial target 150 participants. Trial stopped early for futility (conditional power <35%, effect size close to null). No conflicts of interest declared. Limitations: no pre-defined stratification by diabetes type; unbalanced centre recruitment (82 Toulouse, 9 Bordeaux); no plaque indicators recorded.

trial_design: 2-arm, parallel-design, single-masked, single center, randomized clinical trial
funding_source: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare: 25110601
notes: Sample size: 17 subjects per group needed for 80% power (alpha=0.05), assuming 0.8% HbA1c reduction; 15% attrition assumed, planned n=40. No competing interests declared. Limitations: sample size based on one prior study; treatment by general dentists not periodontists; not all periodontal parameters improved (PCR not significantly improved).

funding_source: European National Fund and National Resources (EPEAEK 2 PYTHAGORAS)
notes: No conflicts of interest declared. Sample size calculated for 90% power to detect 0.4% difference in A1C reduction (minimum 19 patients per group). Authors note small sample size may be subject to selection bias. Control group received minimal treatment (prophylaxis + OHI) rather than no treatment, which may have contributed to non-significant A1C improvement in CG. Seven patients lost to follow-up were analysed under intention-to-treat principle (last observation carried forward).

funding_source: Zhejiang Science and Technology Projects (2009C33168), Natural Science Foundation of Zhejiang Province (Y2100077), Zhejiang Education Committee Projects (Y201017607), National Natural Science Foundation of China (30872884), Zhejiang Health Bureau Fund (2009A104)
notes: No conflict of interest declared. Study limitations: not blinded, single facility, excluded elderly persons, obese subjects, and those with severe diabetic complications. 33 patients dropped out and were excluded from baseline data.

trial_design: 3-arm randomized, parallel-design, double-blinded, controlled clinical trial
funding_source: Health Promotion Fund, Ministry of Health and Welfare, Republic of Korea (#13-15)
notes: Sample size: 72 patients needed (α=0.05, power=0.80, effect size=0.40, 10% dropout); actual 60 analyzed (20/group). No conflict of interest declared. Limitation: SRPAT group had more visits than SRP group, potentially confounding results. Older participant population with complex chronic diseases may introduce bias.
